formTitle: DV-165 Order on Request to Keep Minor's Information Confidential
_comment: DV-165 is the court's order on the DV-160 request - it says "This is a Court Order" on every page, and page 1 says the court completes item 3 if the request is denied or items 4-13 if it is granted. The filer supplies the caption and items 1 and 2, and every one is a name the packet already has: the court (DV-100 caption), the two parties (DV-100 items 1 and 2), and the person making the request (DV-160 item 2a, the filer). Like DV-140 it asks nothing in the packet. Every other field is the judge's, courtUse, named dv165_court_ from its XFA path so no court field shares a filer's name.

fields.label: CONFIDENTIAL version (top of page 1)
fields._why: Which copy of the order this is - confidential or public (redacted) - is the court's and the clerk's to mark.

fields.label: PUBLIC VERSION (REDACTED) (top of page 1)
fields._why: Which copy of the order this is - confidential or public (redacted) - is the court's and the clerk's to mark.

fields.label: 1a. Person who requested restraining order - full name
1b. Person to be restrained - full name
2. Person making request for confidentiality - full name
fields._why: The same person who makes the request on DV-160 item 2a, which carries this name too.
